# EnsoRouterSwapper
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/utils/EnsoRouterSwapper.sol)

**Title:**
EnsoRouterSwapper

Abstract base contract for contracts that route token swaps through
the Enso aggregator router.

Encapsulates the approve → call → reset-allowance pattern used to
interact with Enso. Inheriting contracts call `_ensoSwap` which
reverts on empty calldata or a failed router call.
The router allowance is always reset to zero after the call — whether
the call succeeds, fails, or the router underspends the approval.


## State Variables
### ENSO_ROUTER
The immutable Enso router address all swaps are routed through.


```solidity
address public immutable ENSO_ROUTER
```


## Functions
### constructor


```solidity
constructor(address _ensoRouter) ;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_ensoRouter`|`address`|Address of the deployed Enso router. Must be non-zero.|


### _ensoSwap

Executes a swap through the Enso router.

Reverts with `EmptySwapData` when `data` is empty. Approves
`ENSO_ROUTER` for `amountIn` of `tokenIn`, calls the router, then
unconditionally resets the allowance to zero — even when the router
underspends the approval. Reverts with `SwapFailed` when the
low-level call returns false.


```solidity
function _ensoSwap(address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, bytes calldata data) internal;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`tokenIn`|`address`| The ERC20 token (or ERC4626 share) to swap from.|
|`amountIn`|`uint256`|The amount to approve and expect the router to consume.|
|`data`|`bytes`|    Calldata forwarded verbatim to the Enso router.|


## Errors
### InvalidRouterAddress
Reverts when the provided Enso router address is the zero address.


```solidity
error InvalidRouterAddress();
```

### EmptySwapData
Reverts when `_ensoSwap` is called with empty calldata.


```solidity
error EmptySwapData();
```

### SwapFailed
Reverts when the low-level call to the Enso router returns false.


```solidity
error SwapFailed();
```
